guide.rematter.page.1:
ReMatter Guide

Hand Preparator and
furnace first.
Build a Cell,
Drive, Decomposer
and Synthesizer.
Decompose Sand to
learn its material,
then make Glass. A
Cell holds real
stock; research
never adds matter.
guide.rematter.page.2:
Hand Preparator

Top: Flint, Iron, Flint.
Middle: Copper, Iron,
Copper. Bottom: 3 Iron
Ingots.

Insert feedstock and
press Crank until the
batch finishes.
guide.rematter.page.3:
Extract two fractions

Left input: 1 Sand.
Leave the other two
empty. Crank for 1
Silith.

Collect it; repeat with
1 Clay Ball for 1 Argil.

These are useful
mineral fractions, not
pure elements.
guide.rematter.page.4:
Form the matrix

Left: 1 Silith. Middle: 1
Argil. Right: empty.

Crank for 4 Matrix
Blend. No water
needed.

Process each Blend
in the Hand Preparator
for 1 Matrix Crystal.
guide.rematter.page.5:
Craft parts

Frame: Structural
Bars in the corners,
Iron Ingots along the
edges and Matrix
Blend in the center.

Circuit: Copper Ingots
in the corners,
Redstone above and
below Matrix Blend,
and Argil to its left
and right.
guide.rematter.page.6:
Bars and Racks

Structural Bars: Iron
Ingots across the top
and bottom rows, Silith
left and right in the
middle. Makes 12.

Cell Rack: Bars down
both sides, Control
Circuits top and
bottom center, Silith in
the middle. Makes 2.
guide.rematter.page.7:
64k Matter Cell

Housing: Bars in
the corners, Glass
along the edges.
Stack Circuit,
Matrix Crystal and
Housing. Installed
crystals stay
reusable. A
generator consumes
a loose crystal
instead.
guide.rematter.page.8:
Colored crystals

Mix a Matrix Crystal
in a Preparator with
one dust: Gold: Amber
Copper: Copper
Diamond: Mint
Emerald: Leaf
Lapis Lazuli: Blue
Amethyst: Violet
Silith: Ice
Redstone: Ember.
guide.rematter.page.9:
Starter machines

With Frames, Circuits
and Bars: Preparator:
2 Amber. Decomposer:
2 Copper. Synthesizer:
3 Leaf, Glass. Drive: 1
Mint, 2 Racks.

The recipe book
shows each grid.
guide.rematter.page.10:
First network

Drive: Machine Frames
in the corners, Cell
Racks to either side
of a Control Circuit,
Structural Bars
above and a Mint
Matrix Crystal below.
guide.rematter.page.11:
First network

 Place Decomposer
and Synthesizer
beside the Drive.
Insert a Cell in any
bay and supply FE to
both processors.
guide.rematter.page.12:
Sand into storage

Open Decomposer.
Insert Sand in its
input and press Start.

Its cutter separates
stored Silica into the
connected Drive.

The Cell stays in
storage. Processors
do not accept new
Cells.
guide.rematter.page.13:
Read the tabs

Machine: inputs,
outputs and
upgrades. Settings:
sides, production
and access.
Terminal also has
Machines. Analyzer
has Research.
Preview is separate
from the real
output slot. Hover
for details.
guide.rematter.page.14:
Make glass

Open Recipe, search
Glass and select it.
Use recipe, then Start.

Collect the Glass from
the Synthesizer.

Default: 1 Sand to 1
Glass, 24,000 FE total.
The Cell remains in the
connected Drive.
guide.rematter.page.15:
Control work

Make one queues a
finite batch.
Repeat requests
more until paused.
Pause keeps the
order. Settings
controls automation
and network jobs.
Hoppers can feed
input and remove
actual output.
guide.rematter.page.16:
Why a crystal?

Heating bonds the
mineral blend into a
porous crystal matrix.
Selective storage in
that matrix is fiction,
inspired by real
material separation.

A Cell holds stock.
Recipes describe
products; they add no
matter.
guide.rematter.page.17:
Powered preparation

Material Preparator
uses FE. Inputs run
left to right; unused
slots stay empty.

Grind Iron, Copper or
Gold Ingots into Dust,
1:1, for 4,000 FE each.

No Cell needed.
guide.rematter.page.18:
Five useful fractions

Sand gives Silith. Clay
Ball gives Argil.

Powered preparation
also gives: Redstone:
Rhedon. Quartz: Virel.
Glowstone: Lumin.

Each extraction costs
2,000 FE. Silith + Argil
makes Matrix Blend.
guide.rematter.page.19:
Alloy powders

Powered inputs, left to
right: Rhevon: 3 Iron
Dust, 1 Copper Dust, 1
Rhedon. Lumivex: 3
Copper Dust, 1 Gold
Dust, 1 Lumin.

Each batch makes 4
Powder for 8,000 FE.
Heat next.
guide.rematter.page.20:
Virelite Ceramic

Mix with FE: 1 Silith + 1
Argil + 1 Virel = 4
Virelite Powder.

Sinter Furnace: 1
Powder to 1 Ceramic
for 12,000 FE.

Rhevon and Lumivex
Powder sinter into
Ingots at the same
cost.
guide.rematter.page.21:
Heat and recycle

Alloy Powder smelts
or blasts to Ingots,
1:1.

Preparator, Mekanism
Crusher and Oritech
Pulverizer grind
Ingots back to the
same Powder.

Oritech Foundry: 2
Powders to 2 Ingots.
guide.rematter.page.22:
Advanced powders

Powered, left input
only: Diamond: Powder.
Emerald, Lapis,
Amethyst: Dust. Ender
Pearl: Powder.
Netherite Ingot:
Powder.

No Cell needed.
guide.rematter.page.23:
Component blends

Left, middle, right:
Diamond Powder, 2
Matrix Blend, Gold
Dust.

Ender Pearl Powder, 2
Lumivex Powder,
Copper Dust.

Netherite Powder, 2
Rhevon Powder,
Virelite Powder.
guide.rematter.page.24:
Sinter components

Sinter Furnace, 1
Blend: Diamond Lattice:
12,000 FE. Ender
Conductor: 16,000 FE.
Netherite Sheath:
24,000 FE.

Lattices: circuits,
upgrades. Conductors:
Cells, Ports.
guide.rematter.page.25:
Larger Cells

Each Cell stores up to
512 types. Capacities
are 64k, 256k and 1M
units.

256k uses a Matrix
Cluster and two Ender
guide.rematter.page.26:
Larger Cells

1M uses four
Clusters, an Optical
Circuit, Diamond
Lattice, an Ender
Conductor and a
Netherite Sheath.

Cell front, tier
bar and lamp match
the Drive.
guide.rematter.page.27:
Industrial Preparator

Shell: 3–9 wide and
deep, 5–9 high. Use at
least a 3×4 or 4×3
footprint and 2 Ports.

Cutter + Filter +
Basin. Each mounts on
guide.rematter.page.28:
Preparation
hardware

Cutters give
grinding capacity;
Basins give mixing
capacity. Filters
add Precision.
Hardware does not
grant extra global
speed or FE
savings. Speed and
Efficiency upgrades
do that.
guide.rematter.page.29:
Research a material

Decomposition
consumes a
supported sample
and teaches its
family. The
Analyzer keeps its
sample and spends
FE instead. One
family may cover
several forms.
Imported cells
teach nothing.
guide.rematter.page.30:
Research has limits

Synthesis still
needs an explicit
approved output.
Research cannot
unlock machines,
equipment or parts
for synthesis.
Diamond forms also
need a Pressure
Module. Shared team
knowledge is not
copied on leaving.
guide.rematter.page.31:
Water later

Connect Chemical
Reactor to a Drive
with a Cell. Supply FE.

Import a water bucket
through Decomposer;
keep its input empty.

Choose Water
electrolysis, Use
recipe, then Start.
guide.rematter.page.32:
AE2 and RS

Use one Network
Interface per
system. In
Settings, choose
its backend and
enable automation.
Enable Network jobs
on supported
workers. Crafting
follows the same
research, hardware
and transfer rules.
guide.rematter.page.33:
Industrial Reactor

Use a complete
shell and two or
more Ports. Field
Stabilizers grant
Field; Reaction
Foci add 16,000 u
input room each.
More hardware
unlocks capacity,
not free speed or
FE savings.
guide.rematter.page.34:
Expand the network

Each Drive holds six
removable Cells. Start
with one.

Up to 64 Drives.
Nodes: 256, 384 or
512 by lowest cable
guide.rematter.page.35:
Useful upgrades

Speed adds 25% FE
per upgrade;
Efficiency saves 5%
per upgrade.
Industrial
controllers have
separate Speed,
Efficiency and
Parallel slots.
Height and hardware
limit useful
parallel jobs.
guide.rematter.page.36:
When work waits

Check matter, inputs,
FE and output room.
Cables link the
network and forward
pushed FE.

After a Cell or
guide.rematter.page.37:
When work waits

network change, the
batch restarts by
itself.

Keep unreadable Cells
safe.
guide.rematter.page.38:
Before you start

Early midgame:
external FE, iron,
copper, redstone,
gold, sand, clay and
glass.

The starter Drive
guide.rematter.page.39:
Before you start

needs 1 diamond; the
Synthesizer needs 3
emeralds. Glass
teaches controls.
Build next for silicon,
bronze or steel.
guide.rematter.page.40:
Useful silicon

With a supported
silicon mod, ReForging
uses quartz: 1 quartz
-> 1,000 crystalline
silica -> 1,000 silicon
+ 1,000 oxygen.
guide.rematter.page.41:
Useful silicon

Synthesizer: 250
silicon per item. Four
items cost 160,000
base FE in total. Keep
or explicitly vent new
oxygen.
guide.rematter.page.42:
Reactor processes

The Chemical Reactor
handles electrolysis,
reactions, separation,
heating and cooling.
Soil yields carbon,
silica and water;
carbon helps make
steel.
guide.rematter.page.43:
Crystal outputs

The Material
Synthesizer makes
approved crystals.
Every diamond form
needs a Pressure
Module. Export stored
liquids through the
same Synthesizer.
guide.rematter.page.44:
Air and byproducts

Choose Air oxygen in
the Reactor: 200
oxygen, 16,000 base
FE, 800 ticks.
Overworld, air above
and open sky.
Mekanism tubes can
export oxygen from
guide.rematter.page.45:
Air and byproducts

an automated Drive.

Production settings
can vent selected NEW
gases, after
confirmation. Stored
gas stays safe.
guide.rematter.page.46:
Stock targets

Settings:
Production. A
target of 0
disables the limit.
Processes count
stored substance
and phase; physical
outputs count the
local buffer.
Complete batches
must fit under the
ceiling.
guide.rematter.page.47:
Parallel work

Up to 3 Parallel
Upgrades allow 4
industrial lanes
when height and
hardware permit.
Every batch pays
its full price. All
lanes share the
same matter budget.
Total FE savings
cannot exceed 25%.
guide.rematter.page.48:
Ownership and repairs

Cables and machines
belong to their placer.
Foreign cables do not
connect. FTB Teams
members can operate
devices without
merging stock.
guide.rematter.page.49:
Ownership and repairs

 Invalid chamber: use
Locate missing part.
Close the menu to
follow the outline, then
repair the diagnosed
block.

screen.rematter.converter.unavailable: The selected target is no longer available.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.analyzer: Keeps its sample while learning a material. Needs FE; Derive and Discovery use an explicit Primal Cell.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.decomposer: Consumes supported samples, learns their material and stores their substances in a connected ordinary Matter Cell. Needs FE.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.synthesizer: Makes only explicitly approved, researched materials. Needs FE and ordinary stored matter; diamond forms also need a Pressure Module.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.reactor: Rearranges ordinary stored substances. Needs FE; industrial-only procedures require the larger reactor.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.industrial_rea: Needs a formed shell, Field and process room. Hardware grants capabilities; upgrades control speed, efficiency and parallel jobs.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.preparator: Powered grinding and mixing of physical ingredients. No Matter Cell required.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.hand_preparato: Crank basic recipes without FE. Only an empty, unmodified Hand Preparator can be used for the powered upgrade.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.hand_contents: Holds items or unreadable data. Place and empty it before upgrading.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.industrial_pre: Needs a formed shell and FE. Adds direct chains, exact reclaim, Precision recipes and Assay.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.sinter_furnace: Heats prepared physical batches with FE. Needs no Matter Cell.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.drive: Six removable cell bays. Ordinary matter and Primal reserves stay separate; unknown contents remain preserved.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.terminal: Search shared ordinary stock and inspect authorized connected machines.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.interface: Connects a supported AE2 or RS backend. Native crafting follows the same research and machine gates.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.converter: Explicit finite batches turn a separate Primal Cell into known, allowed solid elements. Never replaces missing ordinary ingredients automatically.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.generator: Standalone fuel: %s FE per permitted crystal, at %s FE/t. Consumes the crystal completely; data packs may disable fuel entries.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.shared_budget: One shared budget per controller. The best usable path wins; equal paths and extra ports do not add their rates.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.grinding: Adds capacity for grinding steps inside an Industrial Preparator; it does not multiply recipe yield.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.mixing: Adds capacity for mixing steps inside an Industrial Preparator; it does not add a global speed bonus.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.precision: Adds Precision for separation and fine workshop recipes. It does not discount FE.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.field: Adds Field. Advanced reactor procedures use Field %s or %s; extra Field does not improve yield or save FE.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.room: Adds %s u of simultaneous recipe-input room. Additional chambers do not add their own speed bonus.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.key_crystal: A reusable functional key when installed in a device. Burning this loose item in an enabled generator consumes it.
guide.rematter.page.50:
Material knowledge

Machine owner and
current team share
knowledge. Personal
discoveries stay
personal; team
knowledge stays
with the team on
leaving. Learn
cheaply from a
sample.
guide.rematter.page.51:
Derive without a
sample

Analyzer Research
can derive a
material if every
required substance
is known. Use its
own Primal Cell.
Base price:
4,000-16,000 u
Primal, 256,000 FE
and 90 seconds. No
item is produced.
guide.rematter.page.52:
Primal Ore

Deepslate Primal
Ore appears in new
Overworld terrain
at y -60 to -24.
Mine with iron
tools or better.
Each ore gives one
Shard. Fortune
gives no bonus;
Silk Touch keeps
the ore.
guide.rematter.page.53:
Other dimensions

Nether Primal Ore
appears at y 16-96.
End Primal Ore is
on outer islands;
the central island
is excluded. All
variants have the
same value. Old
chunks are not
refilled.
guide.rematter.page.54:
Separate Primal
Cells

Primal Cells hold
only Primal Matter:
16k, 64k or 256k u.
A Shard or ore
loads 1,000 u.
Ordinary Cells
reject Primal.
Drive bays can hold
both types, with
separate totals.
guide.rematter.page.55:
Load and move
Primal

Right-click a
Primal Cell with
Shards, ore or
another cell.
Transfer keeps
exact amounts.
Analyzer and
Converter pay only
from their own
payment slot.
guide.rematter.page.56:
Primal Converter

Search a known
solid element by
name or symbol.
Check its ratio.
Insert a Primal
Cell and supply FE.
The flow shows the
output Drive, Cell
bay and free space.
Choose a finite
amount, then Start
and Confirm.
guide.rematter.page.57:
One-way prices

For 1,000 u output:
common elements
cost 1,000 u
Primal; scarce
2,000; invented
4,000. Choose steps
of 250 u. The
window shows exact
FE and time.
Upgrades cannot
improve the Primal
rate.
guide.rematter.page.58:
Discovery Lens

Build the Lens from
8 Primal Crystals
and advanced
optics. Install it
in the Analyzer.
Discovery needs 32
earned materials,
both industrial
structures and the
required owner
dimension visits.
guide.rematter.page.59:
A random discovery

Choose a tier, not
a hidden material.
Discovery finds one
eligible,
still-locked family
in that tier. Base
costs: 16, 32 or 64
Shards and 5, 10 or
20 minutes. The
result is
knowledge, not an
item.
guide.rematter.page.60:
A persistent
project

Pause, reload and
machine changes
keep the same paid
project and hidden
order. Known
targets are
skipped. If the
pool becomes known,
paid Primal is
refunded once.
guide.rematter.page.61:
Reactor hardware

Each Field
Stabilizer adds
Field; special
processes require 4
or 8. Each Reaction
Focus adds 16,000 u
room for active
inputs. Extra empty
shell space does
not multiply
recipes.
guide.rematter.page.62:
Precision and lanes

Filters grant
Precision. Cutters
and Basins provide
capacity for each
step. Height
permits 1-4
industrial lanes,
but Parallel
Upgrades and enough
hardware are also
required.
guide.rematter.page.63:
Hardware colours

Amber crystals:
preparation.
Violet crystals:
reaction.

Hardware grants
capabilities and
room. Upgrades
control work.
guide.rematter.page.64:
One matter budget

Basic: 128 u/t.
Reinforced: 1,024.
Resonant: 8,192.
The best usable
path sets one
budget per
controller. Inputs
and outputs both
count. More equal
cables do not add
speed.
guide.rematter.page.65:
One FE budget

Native cable FE/t:
Basic 2,048;
Reinforced 16,384;
Resonant 131,072.
All controller
ports share their
budget and the
131,072 FE/t total
cap. Additional
cables do not stack
their rates.
guide.rematter.page.66:
Crystal generators

Permitted loose
Matrix Crystals
burn completely for
1,024 FE each by
default. Small: 64
FE/t. Industrial:
256 FE/t. Same fuel
yield. Full output
pauses. Packs may
disable fuels.
Primal is not fuel.
guide.rematter.page.67:
Primal workshop

Precision 4
Industrial
Preparator: 4
Shards + 1 Matrix
Crystal make 1
Primal Crystal.
Preview shows FE
and time. It makes
Lens, Cells and
Links; no Primal
reclaim.
guide.rematter.page.68:
Entangled Link

Shift-right-click
two owned Links
with a Link item.
Maximum 32 blocks,
same dimension,
both ends loaded.
The pair is one
Basic connection.
It loads no chunks
and grants no extra
transfer budget.
guide.rematter.page.69:
Milestones and care

Optional
advancements point
to the next useful
step. They grant no
synthesis
permission. Keep
unreadable cells
and machines safe:
unknown contents
are preserved, not
replaced with empty
stock.
advancement.rematter.start_workshop.desc: Place your first Hand Preparator. Work the crystal chain, then connect a Drive.
advancement.rematter.first_lesson.title: First Lesson
advancement.rematter.first_lesson.descri: Research a material. Try one of its explicitly approved synthesis forms.
advancement.rematter.put_it_back.title: Put It Back
advancement.rematter.put_it_back.descrip: Complete a material synthesis. Compare the exact amount with its decomposition.
advancement.rematter.hands_off.title: Hands Off
advancement.rematter.hands_off.descripti: Complete a native AE2 or RS crafting batch through ReMatter. The same research and machine gates still apply.
advancement.rematter.proper_tools.title: Proper Tools
advancement.rematter.proper_tools.descri: Complete a synthesis that requires the Pressure Module. Hardware and research remain separate conditions.
advancement.rematter.something_older.des: Load a real Primal reserve into a Primal Cell. Research and conversion spend it only when explicitly started.
advancement.rematter.on_paper.title: On Paper
advancement.rematter.on_paper.descriptio: Complete a derivation without a sample. Discovery is a separate late research path.
advancement.rematter.industrial_scale.de: Form a working industrial structure. Inspect Field, Precision and process room.
advancement.rematter.grown_not_mined.des: Complete an industrial crystal-growth process. Item synthesis keeps its own gates.
advancement.rematter.one_way.title: One Way
advancement.rematter.one_way.description: Complete an explicit Primal conversion. Ordinary material can never refill Primal.
screen.rematter.matter_route_hint: Inputs and outputs share this rate across all lanes; equal routes do not add.
screen.rematter.ui.tab_storage_hint: Every substance stored on this Matter Network.
screen.rematter.ui.tab_contents_hint: The cells and substances this device holds.
screen.rematter.ui.tab_machines_hint: Machines on this network. Queue a batch or open one from here.
screen.rematter.ui.tab_research_hint: Material families, Discovery and the current research session.
screen.rematter.filter_solid_hint: Show solids. Without a phase filter every phase is listed.
screen.rematter.filter_liquid_hint: Show liquids. Without a phase filter every phase is listed.
screen.rematter.filter_gas_hint: Show gases. Without a phase filter every phase is listed.
screen.rematter.ui.open_hint: Opens it here. Its back arrow returns to the Terminal.
screen.rematter.primal_source_slot: Primal Shards, Primal Ore or a Primal Cell
screen.rematter.energy.storage_hint: Stored energy, transfer limit and item charging.
screen.rematter.energy.sides_hint: Choose which sides receive or supply energy. A disabled side loses its seat.
screen.rematter.energy.side_tooltip:
%s side (seen from the front)
Now: %s
%s
Left click: next role
Right click or Shift: previous role
screen.rematter.energy.rate_hint: All output faces and charging slots share a total limit of %s FE/t.
screen.rematter.energy.charge_slot_hint: Insert one item that accepts FE. The cube never discharges it.
tooltip.rematter.energy_cube.rate: Transfer: %s FE/t shared across all faces and charging slots
tooltip.rematter.energy_cube.locked: Stored data is protected; contents cannot be used.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.energy_cube: Buffers FE and charges compatible items. Configure input and output faces in Sides. Energy and charging items stay with the cube when moved.
guide.rematter.page.70:
Energy Cubes

Store FE for later.
Basic: 4M FE,
1 charging slot.
Reinforced: 32M FE,
2 slots.
Resonant: 256M FE,
4 slots.

Insert compatible
FE items to charge.
Hover icons for
their full meaning.
guide.rematter.page.71:
Energy sides

Front starts as
Output; other sides
start as Input.
Open Sides to
change each face.

All output faces
and charging slots
share one rate.
Energy and items
stay when the cube
is moved.
item.rematter.matter_cell.transfer_hint: Use a Cell Transfer Station to move substances and configure this Cell.
guide.rematter.page.72:
Cell Transfer
Station

Insert up to three
source Cells on the
left and three
target Cells on the
right. Choose All
or selected
substances, then
Transfer. Only what
fits moves.
Primal Matter stays
separate.
status.rematter.storage_filtered: No Cell filter accepts the output
tooltip.rematter.cell_transfer_station.u: Three source and three target Cells. Move selected substances and configure Cell partitions.
tooltip.rematter.cell_transfer_station.l: Saved data protected. This station cannot be opened by this version.
guide.rematter.page.73:
Partition a Cell

Select its numbered
button in the
Station. Search and
click substance
badges, or copy its
current contents.
The saved list also
applies in Drives.
Existing contents
can always leave.
An empty list
accepts nothing.
screen.rematter.transfer.selection_hint: Choose which substances may leave the source Cells.
screen.rematter.transfer.partition_hint: Configure what each ordinary Cell may accept. The policy travels with the Cell and applies in Matter Drives.
screen.rematter.transfer.move_hint: Move matching contents from all three source Cells into compatible target Cells. Exact leftovers stay in their source.
screen.rematter.transfer.configure_slot: Configure %s. This changes its insertion policy without deleting stored contents.
screen.rematter.transfer.all_hint: Transfer every ordinary substance and Primal Matter into compatible target Cells.
screen.rematter.transfer.only_hint: Transfer only the selected ordinary substances. Enable Primal Matter separately if wanted.
screen.rematter.transfer.primal_hint: Include Primal Matter when transferring selected substances. Ordinary and Primal Cells never mix.
screen.rematter.transfer.clear_hint: Select no ordinary substances and no Primal Matter.
screen.rematter.transfer.any_cell_hint: Remove this ordinary Cell’s partition. Its existing contents stay unchanged.
screen.rematter.transfer.only_cell_hint: Use a whitelist for this Cell. With no substance selected, it accepts nothing. Existing contents remain extractable.
screen.rematter.transfer.contents_hint: Make this Cell accept exactly the substance and phase types it currently contains.
screen.rematter.transfer.clear_cell_hint: Remove all whitelist entries. The Cell accepts nothing until you select substances or choose Accept any. Stored quantities are preserved.
screen.rematter.transfer.fixed_or_unread: Primal Cells have a fixed resource. Unreadable Cells stay protected.
screen.rematter.transfer.preview: Can transfer with the current selection and target partitions:
screen.rematter.transfer.partial: Some saved substance IDs are too long for this editor. Their quantities remain preserved; All can still transfer them to an unrestricted Cell.
screen.rematter.transfer.source_hint: Contents leave this Cell when you press Transfer.
screen.rematter.transfer.target_hint: Receives matching contents that fit its capacity and partition.
screen.rematter.transfer.remove_filter: Click to stop accepting this substance and phase.
screen.rematter.transfer.add_filter: Click to accept this substance and phase.
screen.rematter.transfer.ghost_hint: This is a filter, not an item. Editing it consumes no resources and grants no research.
screen.rematter.transfer.toggle_hint: Click to toggle this substance and phase. Clicking from All starts a new selection.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.cell_transfer: Three source and three target Cells. Select substances to transfer and save substance/phase partitions on ordinary Cells.
screen.rematter.converter.clear_search_h: Show every allowed conversion target again.
screen.rematter.converter.use_target_hin: Select this researched element. The server confirms the current quote before you can start.
screen.rematter.converter.close_hint: Return to the converter without changing its target.
screen.rematter.converter.no_matches: No allowed target matches this search.
screen.rematter.converter.flow_hint: Primal Cell → Primal Converter → ordinary Cell in a Matter Drive.
screen.rematter.converter.destination_hi: Current first fitting Cell. The server checks its partition, type space and free capacity again before delivery. This destination is not reserved.
screen.rematter.converter.destination_he: Connect a Matter Drive through enabled ports. Install an ordinary Cell whose partition accepts the target and has room for the complete batch. Primal Cells hold only Primal Matter.
screen.rematter.converter.destination_re: A compatible output Cell is connected.
screen.rematter.converter.destination_ch: Choose a target to show its destination.
screen.rematter.converter.destination_fu: No compatible Cell has room for this batch.
screen.rematter.converter.need_energy: Supply enough FE for the complete displayed batch.
guide.rematter.page.74:
Connection sides

Fronts never
connect, except
Energy Cubes. Open
bench tops never
connect. Sealed tops
start Disabled;
enable in Sides.
Blank means Disabled.
Left click forward;
right click or Shift
steps back.
guide.rematter.page.75:
Machine motion

Off means idle.
Device colour means
working. Breathing
blue means waiting
for input, output
room, a target or
energy. The menu
gives the current
reason. Moving parts
slow smoothly when
work pauses.
screen.rematter.substance.title: Substance details
screen.rematter.substance.details_hint: Right-click for formula, composition and recipe links.
screen.rematter.substance.primal_storage: Primal Matter stays exclusively in Primal Cells. It is separate from ordinary chemistry.
screen.rematter.substance.read_only: Information only. Viewing recipes does not unlock research or produce matter.
screen.rematter.substance.recipes_hint: Open recipes that produce this substance and phase in EMI.
screen.rematter.substance.uses_hint: Open recipes that consume this substance and phase in EMI.
screen.rematter.substance.back_hint: Return to the machine without changing any selection.
screen.rematter.substance.no_viewer: Install or enable EMI for recipe links.
guide.rematter.page.76:
Substance details

Hover matter for its
exact amount, phase
and type. Right-click
for its formula and
composition. Scroll
the details to read all.

With EMI, use the
recipe and use keys,
or the two link icons.
These views never
unlock research.
